_about: Wanda Gág, Millions of Cats (New York: Coward-McCann, 1928), the Library of Congress copy. US public domain since 2024; Gág died 1946, so UK copyright ended 2016. A picture book: the hand-lettered text is short and the drawings are the work, so the text here is only a pointer to the scan. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv.
